t: Eye wash kit, reliable and wall-mountable first aid solution designed to provide immediate relief in the event of eye injuries. Includes essential components such as eye wash solutions and a mirror for self-treatment, ensuring effective care for eye-related incidents. Designed for quick access in emergencies, ideal for high-risk environments like factories, laboratories, and workshops. Ensures compliance with health and safety regulations, providing a ready-to-use solution for workplace safety. Contains 4 x eye wash pods (5ml), 2 x eye wash pods (20ml), 2 x eye wash bottles (500ml), eye pad and bandage, and pack of tissues
